thread:
mira: Hey team — quick sync on the Summit panel + microdemos plan. Partner wants 3 x 5-min microdemos next to our booth. Need speaker rotation, kit owners, and final shipping address by EOD Tue.

sam: Thanks Mira. Can we confirm AV needs for the microdemos? My assumption: 1 HDMI, 1 USB-C, mic for the presenter.

kate: AV yes, plus we should bring a small USB-C hub, power strip, and HDMI dongle. Also request exhibitor wifi creds ahead of time.

xavier_aws: from marketplace side, Xavier here — we'll send a rep for the panel but can't cover all 3 demos. We can staff demo #2 (marketplace onboarding). Who owns the other two?

mira: Good, thanks. Josh (partner ops) to own demo #1 (hardware-backed quantized model on edge). Kate can own demo #3 (dedicated + private routing example). Xavier covers #2.

josh_partner_ops: I’ll prep the hardware kit. Shipping ETA to Redwood ops by Mon (preference: overnight). Who has the final address?

sam: Use Redwood events receiving:
```
Redwood Inference - Events
Attn: Events Receiving
1201 Market St, Dock 3
San Francisco, CA 94103
Phone: (415) 555-0112
```

mira: Perfect. Josh — please include a quick replacement parts list and a recovery image USB (in case a unit is flaky on site).

josh_partner_ops: Will do. Draft checklist I'm planning to ship with the kit:
- 2x demo laptops (preloaded images)
- 1x companion devkit (edge board)
- 2x power bricks + cords
- 1x HDMI cable, 1x USB-C hub
- 1x recovery USB, 10 spare SATA/USB cables
- printed one-pagers for each microdemo

kate: I'll handle the one-pagers. Can we keep them super concise: 1 headline, 3 bullets, 1 CTA. Also recommend a tiny QR sticker that links to the sandbox.

xavier_aws: On swag — partner will bring 200 stickers and 50 enamel pins. Can Redwood add a small postcard with the promo code for marketplace credits? That usually helps conversions.

mira: Yes — design will be ready by Fri. Sam, can you confirm pocket on the demo table for a postcard stack?

sam: Yep, table layout confirmed. One more ops note: please label all power bricks and dongles with masking tape and a short ID (kit-A, kit-B) so we don't mix them. We lost cords last time :/ :sweat_smile:

josh_partner_ops: Noted, will label and photograph serials before packing. Also adding a lightweight run-of-show for handoffs:

```
14:30 - Panel (30m)
15:15 - Demo setup check (20m)
15:35 - Demo block 1 (5m) - Josh intro -> hardware microdemo
15:45 - Demo block 2 (5m) - Xavier -> marketplace onboarding
15:55 - Demo block 3 (5m) - Kate -> routing/fallbacks
16:05 - Q&A/wrap (10m)
```

mira: Love it. Two asks before Tue EOD: (1) Josh confirm shipping tracking # and kit photo; (2) Xavier confirm the name of the AWS rep so we can put them on the panel slide.

xavier_aws: I'll have rep name by EOD today.

josh_partner_ops: Shipping label created, tracker: 1Z999AA10123456784. Photos will be uploaded to the drive link in #partnerships in ~30m.

deploy-bot: Reminder: Exhibit power draw limit per table is 600W. Please ensure cumulative draw <= limit.

sam: Good catch — Josh please confirm power draw for companion devkit + 2 laptops. If >600W we need a distro M.
josh_partner_ops: Measured: combined peak ~420W. We're good. I'll still bring a small distro for flexibility.

mira: Great progress, team. I'll update the panel slide deck with speaker names and add the postcard CTA. If anything changes ping me directly. :thumbsup:
